entries.name: Creditism
entries.primary_divergence: Non-transferable or purpose-typed credit with separate contribution recognition and settlement deletion circuits.

entries.name: Sovereign Money / 100%-Money
entries.primary_divergence: Transaction-money issuance is institutionally separated from bank lending.

entries.name: Market Socialism / Cooperative Ownership
entries.primary_divergence: Market price coordination is retained while productive ownership and control are socialized or democratized.

entries.name: Democratic Negotiated Planning
entries.primary_divergence: Production and allocation are coordinated through negotiated multi-level plans with substantial local autonomy.

entries.name: Participatory Economics
entries.primary_divergence: Nested participatory councils negotiate consumption and production plans under explicit participation rules.

entries.name: Distributed Commonist Planning
entries.primary_divergence: In-kind mediation and distributed production protocols replace monetary/value mediation.

entries.name: Islamic Risk-Sharing Finance
entries.primary_divergence: Asset-backed and profit/loss-sharing contracts replace interest-centered risk-transfer structures.

entries.name: Community Wealth Building
entries.primary_divergence: Local/community ownership, anchor procurement, and wealth retention redirect accumulation toward place-based control.

entries.name: Post-Growth / Degrowth
entries.primary_divergence: Ecological throughput and social sufficiency are binding macro constraints rather than perpetual GDP growth.

entries.name: Polycentric Commons
entries.primary_divergence: Nested and partially autonomous governance units manage shared resources through locally adapted rules.

entries.name: Participatory Socialism / Predistribution
entries.primary_divergence: Co-determination, broad capital circulation, public provision, and progressive wealth/inheritance taxation reshape ownership power while retaining market allocation.

entries.name: Social Dividend Socialism
entries.primary_divergence: A universal social dividend replaces wage labour as the primary distribution mechanism inside participatory planning.

entries.name: MMT-style Fiscal-Monetary Regime + Job Guarantee
entries.primary_divergence: Sovereign fiscal-monetary coordination is coupled to a standing employment stabilizer.

notes: A registry entry does not imply validation.
Overlays and macro regimes should be composable with whole-system profiles.
Unknown or underdetermined mechanisms must remain explicit rather than inherited from Creditism.
